sentences.en: The match ended in a draw by repetition of moves.
sentences.zh: 由于走法的重复，比赛以平局结束。

sentences.en: Repetition does not transform a lie into a truth.
sentences.zh: 重复不会将谎言变成真理。

sentences.en: Repetition plays a very important role in language learning.
sentences.zh: 在语言学习中，重复起着非常重要的作用。

senses.zh: 重复，反复,背诵,复制品，副本,乐复唱，复奏，重奏
